note: Source for the atd-provenance-signing-v0 corpus. Every key in this file is a TEST key, generated locally for this corpus on 2026-10-05 with node:crypto generateKeyPairSync('ed25519'). None of them is, or is derived from, the production AgentAvow signing key (which lives only in ATTESTATION_SIGNING_KEY_ED25519 and is never committed). The private parts (d) are published here on purpose so that `node generate.mjs` rebuilds the vector file byte for byte. Do not reuse these keys for anything.

issuer.signal_note: vendor.dimension.name (#16). The vendor segment is the id with its trailing .dimension.name peeled off from the right, so a did:web vendor keeps its dots; spec 3a requires it to equal the signed iss, so the signal is registered under the issuer DID itself.

other_issuer.note: A second, fully legitimate issuer that publishes its own key. Used by wrong-iss (its genuine credential presented on agentgraph's signal) and by unpublished-key (its key, presented under agentgraph's iss with the envelope jwks pointing at other.example).

signing.role: did:web:agentgraph.co's current key; its kid is the RFC 7638 thumbprint, computed by generate.mjs

legacy.role: a second key did:web:agentgraph.co publishes under a stable name rather than a thumbprint (mirrors AgentAvow's live kid style, agentgraph-security-v1); used only by the kid-not-thumbprint vector

other.role: did:web:other.example's key, published by that issuer under its thumbprint and NOT by did:web:agentgraph.co; used by the wrong-iss and unpublished-key vectors

observation.explanation: 2 findings: unsafe exec of a model-supplied string; one dependency with a known vulnerability.
